faqs.q: How did you cut checkout drop-off by 30% at eJaby Dubai?
faqs.a: At eJaby by Tekeya in Dubai, I re-architected the entire multi-gateway payment flow using React and TypeScript. I introduced Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe with instant validation, optimistic UI updates, and intelligent fallback retry logic for failed transactions, reducing cart abandonment from 48% to 18%.

faqs.q: What is your architectural approach to Frontend & Full-Stack performance?
faqs.a: I prioritize sub-2s initial load and sub-16ms render frames. My core approach combines strict TypeScript typing, route-based code splitting, memoized state trees, skeleton load states, and Web Workers for heavy data processing. In Node.js backends, I optimize database index paths and enforce structured logging with JWT/RBAC security.

faqs.q: Can you work across UAE, US, and European timezones?
faqs.a: Yes, 100%. Having delivered client work across Dubai (GST, UTC+4), the UK (GMT), Nigeria (WAT, UTC+1), and US remote teams, I maintain overlapping working hours with asynchronous documentation rigor, daily standups, and clear sprint milestones.

faqs.q: What did you achieve as Google Developer Groups Technical Co-Lead?
faqs.a: I led a 200+ member developer community at ACU, teaching hands-on React, Node.js, and API architecture bootcamps. I personally mentored 30+ students directly into junior engineering internships and freelance contracts, and spearheaded our 150+ attendee TechUp Summit.

faqs.q: What are your salary / contract rate expectations?
faqs.a: I am open to competitive full-time roles, contract-to-hire, or high-impact freelance engineering projects. Feel free to send a message via ~/contact.sh or email durojaiyetoluwani@gmail.com to discuss project scopes and compensation.
